title: pi-dynamic-workflows contract runs biome `check` before build/test — only ERRORS gate; FIXABLE WARNINGS proceed
detail: In the contract lane, pi-dynamic-workflows runs `bun run check` (biome) BEFORE build + bun test. A biome ERROR exits the stage with code 1 and build/test never execute, so contract.overallOk=false with no signal on whether the actual tests pass. BUT biome FIXABLE WARNINGS are non-blocking: run 2026-07-04T04-50-16 emitted 2 warnings (noUnusedVariables 'pi' in task-panel.test.ts:417; noUnusedImports in workflow-manager.test.ts:1) yet tsc build was clean and bun test passed 768/0 — pdw contract green. Recurring fixable warning locations observed across runs: organizeImports import-sort in workflow.test.ts; noUnusedVariables in task-panel.test.ts; noUnusedImports in workflow-manager.test.ts. When pdw fails the contract lane on biome, distinguish ERROR (gates, masks tests) from WARNING (proceeds) — re-run `bun run build && bun test` locally to separate lint drift from a real test regression before diagnosing.

title: build lane (build:all + verify e2e) is stable and green across runs
detail: The build lane consistently produces a working pi-agent bundle + standalone binary and passes the verify e2e gate. Observed 2026-07-04: buildAllOk=true, verifyOk=true. Confirmed 2026-07-05: buildAllOk=true (bundle + minify → dist/pi-agent/pi-agent.js 6.8 MB + .map, standalone 70.2 MB, symlink node_modules, copy theme/export-html/assets), verifyOk=true (1 pass, 25 skip, 0 fail — getAllTools() probe clean). Artifacts: dist/pi-agent/pi-agent.js + pi-agent.js.map; symlink node_modules → pi deps store; standalone binary dist/pi-agent/pi-agent (70.2 MB); copied assets (theme/, export-html/, assets/). Modes: bundle+minify + standalone binary compile. verify (e2e-extensions.test.ts): 1 pass, 25 skip, 0 fail, 5 expect() calls (3.20s), no extension-load errors. Treat build-lane failures as environmental/sandbox, not code regressions, unless reproducible.

title: fix:true refuses on dirty tree — workflow's OWN emitted artifacts count as dirty
detail: The fix lane (effort:medium + fix:true) correctly refuses to apply when the git tree is dirty. Gotcha: the workflow's OWN emitted/persisted artifacts are themselves counted as dirty, so a prior or concurrent self-improve run leaves the tree blocked even when no real source changed. Run 2026-07-04T04-50-16 fix was skipped with porcelain listing exactly: .claude/workflows/_shared-patterns.md, .claude/workflows/pi-agent-ext-flux2-self-improve.knowledge.jsonl, .claude/workflows/pi-infra-self-improve.js. To unblock fix:true: commit/stash these workflow artifacts (or run fix in isolation on a clean checkout) before invoking. Do NOT treat this skip as a code regression — it is by-design collision avoidance. This run (2026-07-05T12-20-49) fix was null — not attempted, so this observation remains unconfirmed in a fix-lane-active context.

title: L2 tests (LLM-dependent) consistently time out at 5000ms across packages
detail: Two separate packages show L2 test failures from timeout at the same 5000ms threshold. pi-agent: 6 L2 tests timed out (context_analyzer, agent_inventory, extension_analyzer, graph_health, ask_user_question, goal_complete — 6 errors). pi-agent-ext-power-tool: 8 L2 tests failed at the same threshold (context_analyzer, agent_inventory, extension_analyzer, knowledge_query, graph_health, todo, ask_user_question, goal_complete). Both share test sets that depend on LLM agent response within 5000ms. The overlap (context_analyzer, agent_inventory, extension_analyzer, graph_health, ask_user_question, goal_complete) suggests these tests require a fast LLM response that the local model (gemma-4-26b-a4b-qat via LM Studio) cannot sustain under load. These are NOT code regressions — they are infrastructure/environment capacity limits. When diagnosing a failed contract lane, grep for L2 timeout failures first; if the only failures are LLM-dependent timeouts, treat as infra issue, not code regression.

title: pi-agent-cli findCommandToken does not respect `--` end-of-options separator — reserved words after `--` dispatched as commands
detail: A correctness bug in bun-apps/pi-agent-cli/src/cli.ts (findCommandToken). When a user passes `--` to mark the end of options, parsePiArgs correctly puts everything after it into positionals. But findCommandToken selects the first positional and checks RESERVED before verifying whether it came from pre-`--` or post-`--` context. So `bun-pi-agent-cli -- flux2 generate a cube` dispatches flux2 as a command instead of treating it as passthrough input. The `--` contract says every subsequent token becomes a positional verbatim (flag-parsing disabled) but the command dispatcher still intercepts reserved words. Affects any passthrough prompt starting with a reserved keyword (flux2, ltx, krea2, power-tool, etc.). Fix: findCommandToken should skip over positionals that originated after `--` before checking RESERVED.

title: PI_THINKING env var cast as ThinkingLevel without validation in pi-vlm — silent invalid value passthrough
detail: Cross-package inconsistency: pi-agent-cli/src/shared.ts validates PI_THINKING with isThinkingLevel() and throws on invalid values ('Invalid PI_THINKING "bogus". Valid: off, minimal, low, medium, high, xhigh'). But pi-vlm/src/sessions.ts does `(process.env.PI_THINKING ?? 'off') as ThinkingLevel` — zero validation, just a type assertion. A typo like PI_THINKING=bogus silently passes 'bogus' as ThinkingLevel to createAgentSessionFromServices, producing undefined behavior or aborted session deep in the SDK without a helpful error message. Fix: import/duplicate the isThinkingLevel() guard from pi-agent-cli/shared.ts into pi-vlm/sessions.ts, or extract shared validation into a common package.

title: pi-vlm session-factory resolveModel does not bake PROVIDERS — silent failure where CLI works
detail: Cross-package inconsistency: pi-agent-cli's shared.ts calls buildBakedRegistry() which registers lm-studio providers (etc.) before resolving models. But pi-vlm's session-factory.ts (resolveModel in createSharedSession) calls createAgentSessionServices({modelRegistry: undefined}) which loads only the bare global registry (~/.pi/agent/models.json) — NO baked providers. If no models.json exists but LM Studio works via pi-agent's baked PROVIDERS, the CLI (`bun-pi-agent-cli vlm-describe paper.pdf`) works fine, but the pi-extension (e.g., obsidian's vlm_describe tool) fails with 'Module not found' or 'Available (0) models'. The fix should propagate the same buildBakedRegistry() pattern to pi-vlm's session-factory, or factor provider baking into a shared utility.

title: assertWritablePath blocklist uses exact-case comparison — bypassable on case-insensitive filesystems
detail: A security-relevant correctness bug in bun-apps/pi-obsidian/extensions/obsidian.ts (assertWritablePath). The WRITE_BLOCKLIST check uses `['.git', '.obsidian'].includes(first)` which is exact-case string comparison. On case-insensitive filesystems (macOS APFS/HFS+ default), `.Git`, `.GIT`, `.Obsidian`, `.OBSIDIAN` bypass the blocklist and allow writes to git/Obsidian internal directories. An agent obsidian_create tool receiving note path `.Git/config` or `.OBSIDIAN/app.json` will proceed to overwrite critical configuration files. Fix: use a case-insensitive comparison (`.toLowerCase()` or case-insensitive regex) on the first path segment against the blocklist entries, or use realpath resolution and compare against disallowed canonical paths.

title: onProgress called bare in stream 'data' handler without try/catch — uncaught exception leaves Promise unsettled
detail: A bug pattern present in two extension packages (pi-agent-ext-flux2/src/invoke.ts and pi-agent-ext-krea2/src/invoke.ts). opts.onProgress is called directly inside the ReadableStream 'data' event handler without a try/catch wrapper. If onProgress throws (e.g., TypeError from a caller's progress adapter), the exception fires inside a Node.js read stream event handler — outside the enclosing Promise constructor — so it surfaces as an uncaught exception instead of being caught by the invoke promise resolution. The child process finishes but the promise never resolves, leaking the subprocess. pi-agent-ext-ltx/src/invoke.ts already fixed this (wraps onProgress in try/catch with a comment explaining the issue), establishing the fix pattern. New code should wrap all progress callbacks in stream handlers with try/catch.

title: saveToDisk temp dirs orphaned on process crash — no startup cleanup accumulates waste
detail: A reliability issue in bun-apps/pi-hermes-memory/src/store/memory-store.ts (saveToDisk). The method creates a temp dir via fs.mkdtemp inside memoryDir, writes a temp file, and renames atomically. The finally block cleans up on normal flow. But on process crash between mkdtemp and rename completion, the `.tmp-XXXXXX/` directory is orphaned with no cleanup mechanism — it persists across restarts. Over repeated crashes (SIGKILL, battery drain, kernel memory pressure), hundreds of orphaned `.tmp-XXXXXX/` dirs accumulate, wasting inodes and disk space. No startup-scan cleanup exists to reclaim them. Fix: add a startup cleanup step (e.g., rmSync on all .tmp-* dirs inside memoryDir on initialization) or use a system temp dir (os.tmpdir()) that is cleaned by the OS.
